# Patrick Industries Releases 2024 Annual Report: A Year of Strategic Momentum and Purposeful Growth


04/03/2025


Patrick Industries published the company’s 2024 Annual Report, highlighting a year defined by strategic diversification, resilient performance, and focused investment in the future. With $3.7 billion in sales, strong free cash flow, and continued capital allocation to growth platforms like Powersports and Aftermarket, Patrick remains well-positioned to serve and empower enthusiasts across the Outdoor Recreation space.


[View the full report.](https://patrickind.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Patrick-2024-Annual-Report.pdf)
